The laboratory app has one component that calls the framework `useVisit`. Patient-management has five, and each destructures `activeVisit`, so a rename would break all six.

**Laboratory app**
- `AddTestOrderButton` calls `useVisit(selectedPatient?.uuid)` and destructures `activeVisit`, `error`, `isLoading` (`openmrs-esm-laboratory-app/src/components/add-test-order/add-test-order-button.component.tsx:27`, component at lines 17–127).

**Patient-management**
- `CreateAdmissionEncounterWorkspace` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-ward-app/src/ward-workspace/create-admission-encounter/create-admission-encounter.workspace.tsx:48`, component at lines 32–205) destructures `activeVisit`.
- `CreateQueueEntryWorkspace` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/create-queue-entry.workspace.tsx:47`, component at lines 31–120) destructures `activeVisit`.
- `PatientBanner` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search-page/patient-banner/banner/patient-banner.component.tsx:46`, component at lines 42–160) destructures `activeVisit`. It also uses `activeVisit` in the `selectPatientButton` disabled check.
- `EndAppointmentModal` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-appointments-app/src/appointments/common-components/end-appointment.modal.tsx:16`, component at lines 14–99) destructures `activeVisit` and `mutate`.
- `AddOrMoveOverflowMenuItem` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/add-or-move-button/add-or-move-overflow-menu-item.extension.tsx:12`, component at lines 10–30) destructures `activeVisit` and `isLoading`.

**Excluded**
- `useVisit` defined locally in `esm-active-visits-app/src/visits-summary/visit.resource.ts` and `esm-service-queues-app/src/current-visit/current-visit.resource.ts`. Their callers, `visit-detail.component.tsx` and `current-visit-summary.component.tsx`, are not affected by a framework change.
- `patient-search-views.component.tsx:76` mentions `useVisit` only in a comment.
- The laboratory test file `add-test-order-button.test.tsx` and the patient-management test files only mock the hook. They would need updating too, but they don't call it in production code.
